required_gates.pass_when: Every external capability used is permitted by sources.json at its current trust class and any required promotion evidence exists.
All project-required build, typecheck, lint, or compile commands affected by the change complete successfully.
Changed rendered routes introduce no new relevant browser console errors and no unexplained relevant failed network requests.
Changed rendered surfaces pass the repository viewport matrix, or the fallback mobile/tablet/desktop matrix when none exists.
Changed controls and flows retain semantic labeling, keyboard operation, visible focus, usable errors/recovery, and applicable project accessibility checks.
Material user flows affected by the change complete in a real browser with expected state transitions.
Applicable findings from the current official Vercel Web Interface Guidelines are resolved or explicitly documented as non-applicable with evidence.

Stable project visual assertions pass, or visual regression is explicitly not_applicable because no rendered UI changed. Missing browser tooling is not a not_applicable reason for rendered UI changes.
